|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata versions are [[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image shown here both print this text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. The Circle Is Now Complete is canceled. While present with [Reflections 3] Obi-Wan or a Jedi Council Member, lightsabers here may not be 'swung' twice, their immunity to attrition is canceled and you may add one battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) dropped “here” from “lightsabers here may not be 'swung' twice”: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. The Circle Is Now Complete is canceled. While present with [Reflections 3] Obi-Wan or a Jedi Council Member, lightsabers may not be 'swung' twice, their immunity to attrition is canceled and you may add one battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.”.<ref name="cl-1261_10-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Darth Vader, Betrayer Of The Jedi (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) moved “may add one battle destiny” to the front, restored “here” and changed “twice, their” to “twice, and their”: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. The Circle Is Now Complete is canceled. While present with [Reflections 3] Obi-Wan or a Jedi Council Member, may add one battle destiny, lightsabers here may not be 'swung' twice, and their immunity to attrition is canceled. Immune to attrition < 5.”.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee announced this text on 19 October 2012, effective immediately, to show that Vader's added battle destiny is not a global effect<ref name="pcforum-p761411">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 19 October 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p761411 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
